verdict.rationale: Mercury's bill-pay feature lets you upload/email bills with AI auto-populating details before you 'approve and pay' (mercury-docs-3, mercury-docs-28), and its API/CLI expose 'SendMoneyApprovalRequests' and 'Safe' request resources alongside granular permissions for who can pay (mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-11, mercury-probe-3, mercury-probe-5), showing an underlying approval-routing mechanism. However, there's no detailed documentation of multi-step approval chains, threshold rules, or a hands-on walkthrough of the vendor-bill-to-payment workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable approval steps/thresholds, independent/hands-on confirmation of the bill-to-payment approval flow, and detail on how approvers are routed for a given bill.
